notes.title: Thanks For an Amazing Launch!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! If you're reading this, I want to say thank you for supporting the launch of my first steam game, Champion's Chalice! Over the past two weeks, I've received a lot of great feedback which will help me improve the game in the months to come. 

As for what's next:
[olist]
[*]  Fixing bugs. I've compiled a list of known bugs, and am currently working on a patch to get them fixed. Rest assured, I will have this update out as soon as it's ready! 
[*] Free content update: Once I take care of the bugs, my tentative plan is to begin work on a free content update. I intend to include some cut content which didn't make it into the 1.0 release as well new units and items. 
[/olist]
Stay tuned! 

Thanks again, 
Tony

notes.title: Official Release Date: Feb. 2nd!
notes.content: After two years of hard work, it's finally time for the release of Champion's Chalice! The game will be available on Feb. 2nd. I hope you enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed making it.

notes.title: Champion's Chalice at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest October 2023 edition is here! As we get closer and closer to the release date (an official announcement will be coming soon), we're here at Steam Next Fest to show off what Champion's Chalice has to offer. For the first ever, Champion's Chalice is now publicly available for you to try by way of our exclusive demo on steam. 

If you're a fan of turn-based Autobattlers or Roguelikes with deep strategy and tactics, give Champion's Chalice a try!

notes.title: Official Announcement!
notes.content: After starting this project over a year ago, the day has finally come to launch the steam page for Champion's Chalice! As we approach the official release, I'll post further updates here whenever I have something interesting to share. Thanks for checking the game out, and I'm super excited for what's to come. [b]Stay tuned![/b]
